name: westerm

scripts.dev:server: cargo run --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml -- serve --allow-origin http://localhost:5173 --allow-origin http://127.0.0.1:5173
scripts.test: node --import tsx --test tests/*.test.ts && cargo test --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml

description: Web Session Terminal: a web terminal whose sessions survive closed tabs, restarts, and reboots. Built on wterm.
